title: Per-thread sandbox computer behind a SandboxBackend seam: microVM backend, persistent thread workspace, typed executor protocol and visible lifecycle
summary: Add a SandboxBackend trait to sandbox-manager (leases already carry backend_id and endpoint) with bwrap as implementation 1 and a microVM backend (Firecracker or Kata, or one attested managed provider) as implementation 2 that stops when idle and snapshots to encrypted object storage. Extend the CAS workspace from Space scope to thread scope, define a typed executor protocol (the cloud loop proposes, the host executes), expose lifecycle states, typed failure causes and a heartbeat in the UI, and harden path handling.
whyItMatters: Every 'do the work' reference (Manus, ChatGPT agent, claude.ai, Perplexity) gives each task its own computer; Verevon runs hermetic per-call bwrap processes inside the execution-core container that cannot install tools, keep state or host a browser or desktop. This is the foundation for file analysis at scale, app building, the computer panel and computer use, and it is the biggest single architectural gap against the Manus/Claude vision.

title: Connected apps that work in chat: prove Gmail, Outlook, Drive and Calendar reads end to end, add Ask-mode reads, @-connector scoping, citations, then approved writes
summary: integration-corev2 already implements real read operations (mail search and get, Drive search and content, windowed calendar). Close the Model Plane half: update execution-core's agent catalogue to the real operations, ship the read-only provider tool that does not stall on approval, expose the same reads in Ask mode behind the source-scope filter, add @connector mention and per-turn account scoping, cite connector sources, live-prove against real mailboxes, then enable writes behind per-action approval.
whyItMatters: Connected apps are table-stakes (6 of 11) and the main way a B2B assistant becomes useful on a user's own data. The plumbing exists on both sides but has never run end to end against a real account, and Ask-mode reads are parked (F12), so users cannot ask about their own mail in normal chat.

title: Finish human-in-the-loop: plan approve-then-continue, a typed ask_user tool, and docked approval, plan, question and queue trays
summary: After a plan is approved the run continues on its own (grant and plan persisted in session-core, no extra user message). Add ask_user as a non-effectful builtin in both loops: a durable pause with a user_question ChatEvent and a card that supports single/multi select, free text and skip, resumed through the existing route. Render pending approvals, plan proposals, questions and the message queue as trays docked above the composer in priority order.
whyItMatters: Plan mode is table-stakes (9 of 12) and structured clarifying questions are common (6 of 12). Verevon has the editable plan card but the run stops after approval and there is no way for the agent to ask a question, so agents either guess or stall. Docked trays (Cursor, DeepSeek) keep the request visible during long runs.

title: Make Spaces the chat project: instructions, knowledge, members and a retrieval indicator in Ask and Do
summary: Replace the browser-only localStorage project organiser with Space-backed projects. A Space already carries governed instructions, Data Plane v2 knowledge and members, so add a project picker and folder view to the chat sidebar, apply Space instructions and retrieval scope in Do runs as well as Ask, and show a knowledge-mode indicator (in context versus retrieval). Also confirm and expose the multi-author Space room threads that session-core already stores.
whyItMatters: Projects are how every comparable product organises ongoing work (7 of 12 sources) and, for Verevon, they are the container that carries org governance: who sees what and which knowledge a run may retrieve. Knowledge stays in context while it fits and switches to a retrieval tool when it outgrows the window, with a visible indicator (Claude, claude.ai). Real-time multi-user use (C-031) is DOC-only: Manus lets up to 49 collaborators instruct one task, Perplexity uses head-checked optimistic concurrency.

SPA: migrate the local organiser into server-synced Space folders (plan I21), add a project picker to the chat sidebar and composer, and render a knowledge-mode badge from the existing retrieval_notice event.
